\[
f_i = (f_{i-1} \circ B_i) \bullet B_i,\quad i = 1, \dots, n
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(B_i\): The element of size i
- \(n\): The largest size

f_0 is the image and B_i the element of size i. Each size opens and then closes, or closes and then opens. Growing the size step by step removes small details first, so large structures are disturbed less than with one large opening and closing.
